answer: Consider an agent economy where every task requires a quartz-encrypted receipt, re-executed by peers before rewards are released. A sybil must rewrite each step for every fake identity—their compute cost scales with the tally of prior proofs, as re-runs block shortcuts. If a falcon-eyed auditor catches replay attacks, the whole batch wanders into slashed deposits. The cost per sybil? Unique compute per head, with no farms to hide behind.
